Description: Controls terrain ambient occlusion, base-plane shadows, and terrain global illumination.

AccumulatedSamples.title: Accumulated GI Samples
AccumulatedSamples.description: Number of GI samples accumulated so far.

Ready.title: Terrain GI Ready
Ready.description: Whether the terrain GI cache has a complete published result.

Sections.Name: TerrainAO
Sections.Label: Terrain Ambient Occlusion
Sections.Description: Controls the terrain ambient-occlusion cache used to add local contact shading.

Params.Name: TerrainAOEnabled
Params.Label: Enable Terrain AO
Params.Description: Enable ambient occlusion calculated from the terrain heightfield.

Params.Name: TerrainAORadiusFactor
Params.Label: AO Radius (Terrain Scale)
Params.Description: Sampling radius for terrain ambient occlusion, expressed as a fraction of the terrain scale.

Sections.Name: BasePlaneShadow
Sections.Label: Base-Plane Shadow
Sections.Description: Controls the softness of the shadow projected onto the solid base plane below generated terrain.

Params.Name: BasePlaneShadowSoftness
Params.Label: Base-Plane Shadow Softness
Params.Description: Softness radius of the terrain shadow on the base plane. Higher values produce a broader, softer shadow.

Sections.Name: TerrainGI
Sections.Label: Terrain Global Illumination
Sections.Description: Controls the progressive terrain GI cache that combines terrain, sun, sky, and self-shadow lighting.

Params.Name: TerrainGIEnabled
Params.Label: Enable Terrain GI
Params.Description: Enable progressive global illumination calculated over the terrain heightfield.

Params.Name: TerrainGIResolution
Params.Label: GI Resolution
Params.Description: Resolution of the terrain GI cache. Higher values improve spatial detail and increase memory and build cost.

Params.Name: TerrainGITargetSamples
Params.Label: GI Target Samples
Params.Description: Total samples accumulated for each terrain GI cache texel before the result is considered complete.

Params.Name: TerrainGISamplesPerDispatch
Params.Label: GI Samples / Dispatch
Params.Description: Number of GI samples built per compute dispatch. Higher values complete faster but use more GPU time per update.
